ruleDefinitions.name: Computer Password Change Via Ksetup.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects password change for the computer's domain account or host principal via "ksetup.exe"

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\ksetup\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ksetup\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/setcomputerpassword\\ .*"))
